title: Theatre kept Depression audiences going
summary: Green says the country had to keep on its toes to overcome the Depression and theatres were a main outlet, so they did well.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: And what was happening to other tap
dancers? Was Hollywood at a boom at that point?

Yeah. The whole country had to get on their toes, you know. To keep from thinking about the Depression. They was supposed to overcome the Depression. Like the series they've been having here recently, where the city went into some kind of budget disruption or something. Well, the Depression was similar.
But you were doing all right during the Depression.

Yeah, we were, because of -- that was one of the main things about the country at that time, was theaters, entertainment. That was a good outlet for people, to overcome their worries, see, financial responsibilities, I should say.
